# Coherent Optical Communication DSP: Pure NumPy Comparison Version
This is a low-level DSP simulation implemented using pure NumPy and SciPy. In this version, the CMA equalizer and CPR phase-locked loop are manually calculated step-by-step using Python's native for loop. You can experience the difference in time consumption compared to the JAX version when adjusting the slider below!
